payload.title: Outbound email public surface: export FrickEmailAdapter + Resend reference, wire to auth flows
payload.description:
Outbound email router/adapters (incl. a Resend adapter reading RESEND_API_KEY) live under apps/server/src/email/* for tests/framework work but are NOT exported from @frick/server or documented as an app surface (status.md:84-87; operations.md:839-847).

Scope: design + export a documented FrickEmailAdapter interface, ship the Resend reference adapter publicly, and wire it into identity password-reset + first-sign-in flows.
Size: M.
